[SWS_CANIF_00967] Support of meta data type TIMETUPLE_TYPE_PTR at recep-
tion indication
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_02004
⌈If MetaData item TIMETUPLE_TYPE_PTR is configured for a received L-SDU, CanIf
shall transfer the ingress time stamp of the received L-SDU to the MetaDataItem of
type TIMETUPLE_TYPE_PTR.⌋
